http/internal/http2_body#

Bodies of HTTP/2 streams: a buffer per stream filled by DATA frames and read by the application, returning flow-control credit as it is read.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Bodies of HTTP/2 streams: a buffer per stream filled by DATA frames and read by the application, returning flow-control credit as it is read.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

role Http2BodyEvents#

role Http2BodyEvents

Owner charges connection DATA before calling data(), and queues returned credit synchronously. Buffer owns only this stream's storage/read lifetime.

Http2BodyEvents.credit#

credit(stream is int, amount is int, stream_update is bool) is void

amount bytes of stream were read; stream_update says whether to update the stream window too.

Http2BodyEvents.discard#

discard(stream is int, amount is int, cancel is bool) is void

amount bytes of stream were dropped; cancel says whether to reset the stream.
